name: chase-border-card
title: Chase Border Card
author: HoverUI (https://hoverui.com)
description: A gradient border turns while hovered — seven seconds a revolution — and coasts to a stop on leave rather than cutting. Re-entering mid-coast resumes the turn from where it was, never from zero. Keyboard focus inside the card drives it too, so put something focusable in your content. Reduced motion shows the ring without turning it; on touch and any device without hover the ring rests visible and still. Note: the component pins position, isolation and overflow on its own root, so content that must escape the card's bounds will be clipped.
